title: Micron’s AI Repricing Is Real — But the Market Still Isn’t Sure It Can Last
excerpt: Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU)’s recent earnings growth has been so rapid that it nearly appears to be a new firm rather than a cyclical memory maker. T...
content_html:
Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU)'s recent earnings growth has been so rapid that it nearly appears to be a new firm rather than a cyclical memory maker. The company has gone from a negative $5.34 EPS trough in fiscal year 2023 to an estimated $73.23 EPS in fiscal year 2026, prompting investors to ask a more fundamental question: has high-bandwidth memory truly broken Micron's historical boom-bust pattern?

Historic Earnings Trends

The immediate bullish argument is based on undeniable practical facts. Micron is no longer just a commodity DRAM and NAND supplier, as the company has evolved into an integral component of the global AI hardware architecture. High-bandwidth memory chips stacked directly on powerful AI processors, such as NVIDIA's next-generation graphics processing units, have made memory the key system bottleneck for training and deploying LLMs.

This shift was apparent in the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, when the company's revenue surpassed consensus projections of $35.69 billion. Over the last year, average earnings projections for Micron have been adjusted upward by 794%, indicating a significant revision of the company's long-term earning power among Wall Street research desks.

Micron's Valuation Anomaly

However, even with this operational momentum, a significant disparity exists between Micron's market valuation and its underlying profitability indicators. The stock is currently trading at a forward price-to-earnings multiple of just 6.2x, despite a return on equity of 66.6% and gross margins of 84%. This disparity hints that the market views Micron as a legacy semiconductor manufacturer destined to experience immediate mean reversion. That said, assessing the company solely on historical cyclical trends ignores the multi-year commitments that back up Micron's cash flow.

That structural security is supported by multi-year supply agreements that span the whole AI ecosystem. Micron reported that its long-term client agreements now total more than $100 billion in minimum contracted revenue, with contractual price floors designed to safeguard gross margins of more than 70%. Moreover, Micron's entire HBM production allocation for fiscal year 2026 has already been sold out, with management indicating that supply shortages will likely continue beyond 2027.

The Burry Bear Case Vs. the Structural Moat

Skeptics argue that Micron's turbulent history warrants a long-term valuation discount. During the last downturn, the company's gross margin fell from 45.2% in 2022 to a mere 2.7% in 2023, showing how quickly semiconductor cycles can fall apart when end-market demand falls or global capacity overshoots. Moreover, high-profile short positions, notably Michael Burry's publicly stated short position, reflect macro bears' persistent confidence that capacity expansion will eventually swamp the market and cause another major margin contraction.

content_html_zh:
美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）最近的盈利增长如此之快，以至于它几乎看起来像是一家新公司，而不是一家周期性内存制造商。 该公司的每股收益已从 2023 财年的 5.34 美元的负谷值跌至 2026 财年的预计每股收益 73.23 美元，这促使投资者提出一个更基本的问题：高带宽内存是否真正打破了美光历史上繁荣-萧条的模式？

历史盈利趋势

直接看涨的论点是基于不可否认的实际事实。 美光不再只是一家商品 DRAM 和 NAND 供应商，该公司已发展成为全球人工智能硬件架构中不可或缺的组成部分。 高带宽内存芯片直接堆叠在强大的 AI 处理器（例如 NVIDIA 的下一代图形处理单元）上，使得内存成为训练和部署 LLM 的关键系统瓶颈。

这种转变在 2026 财年第三季度表现得很明显，当时该公司的收入超过了 356.9 亿美元的共识预测。 去年，美光科技的平均盈利预测上调了 794%，这表明华尔街研究机构对该公司的长期盈利能力进行了重大修正。

美光科技的估值异常

然而，即使有这种运营势头，美光的市场估值与其基本盈利指标之间仍存在显着差异。 尽管股本回报率为 66.6%，毛利率为 84%，但该股目前的预期市盈率仅为 6.2 倍。 这种差异暗示市场将美光视为一家传统半导体制造商，注定会立即出现均值回归。 也就是说，仅根据历史周期性趋势评估该公司忽略了支持美光现金流的多年承诺。

这种结构性安全得到了涵盖整个人工智能生态系统的多年供应协议的支持。 美光报告称，其长期客户协议目前的最低合同收入总额超过 1000 亿美元，合同价格下限旨在保证毛利率超过 70%。 此外，美光 2026 财年的全部 HBM 生产分配已经售罄，管理层表示供应短缺可能会持续到 2027 年之后。

巴里熊案与。 结构护城河

怀疑论者认为，美光科技动荡的历史值得长期估值折扣。 在上次经济低迷期间，该公司的毛利率从 2022 年的 45.2% 下降至 2023 年的仅为 2.7%，这表明当终端市场需求下降或全球产能超调时，半导体周期崩溃的速度有多快。 此外，高调的空头头寸，尤其是迈克尔·伯里(Michael Burry)公开声明的空头头寸，反映出宏观空头的持续信心，即产能扩张最终将淹没市场并导致另一次大幅利润收缩。
